name: vault-mind
description: An AI operating layer for your personal knowledge vault.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.vault:build: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js build --out vault
scripts.vault:init: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js init --path vault
scripts.vault:health: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js health --path vault
scripts.vault:review: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js review --path vault
scripts.vault:architect: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js architect --vault vault
scripts.vault:antipatterns: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js antipatterns --vault vault
